answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that vests slowly, like an orchard maturing over seasons: new identities earn only yarrow-level micro-rewards until their stake and attestation history prove real work, while established agents' attestations carry velvet-smooth weight. A Sybil farm must fund every fake identity's stake and wait out the vesting window, so cloning identities costs more than the rewards they can harvest.
